twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.description: Add verification from an authenticator app after your password.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or a compatible app, or enter the key manually. Setup expires in 10 minutes.
twoFactor.codesHint: These codes are shown only once. Each works once. Store them somewhere safe to sign in if you lose your authenticator.
twoFactor.disableHint: Sign-in will only require your password. All old sessions will expire; this device receives a new session.
twoFactor.regenerateHint: All old recovery codes will stop working. Enter your password and a valid authenticator or recovery code.
twoFactor.reuseHint: Each authenticator code works once. If you just used it, wait for the next code or use a recovery code.
twoFactor.required: Enter your current password and the required code.
twoFactor.codeRequired: Enter an authenticator or recovery code
twoFactor.loginHint: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator, or a saved recovery code. This step expires in 5 minutes.

backup.enabledHint: Manual backups remain available when disabled. Missed runs during downtime are skipped.
backup.retainCountHint: Manual and scheduled backups share the limit. Excess copies are removed after the next backup; untracked older files are left untouched.
backup.invalidRetainCount: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
backup.skipUnchanged: Back up only when data changes
backup.skipUnchangedHint: Signing in, reading maps, and viewing shares do not count as content changes.

backup.invalidSchedule: The Cron expression or time zone is invalid, or no execution date exists.
backup.davURLHint: Use the full destination directory URL. Missing directories will be created when possible.

backup.started: Backup started. Follow its progress below.
backup.saveFirst: Save your changes before starting a backup.

backup.confirmCheckbox: I confirm replacing the current site data with this backup.
backup.restoreStarted: Restoration started. Sign in again when it finishes to view the result.
backup.historyDescription: The most recent 20 job results, separate from the number of backup copies retained.
backup.noHistory: No backup or restore jobs yet.

jobErrors.CAPTURE_FAILED: Snapshot failed. Check the database, file permissions, and free space.

backup.operationFailed: Operation failed. Check the server logs.
